name: a pay-what-you-want card with cursor press
looks: A product cover sits beside a short pricing statement, a price field and a dark call-to-action button underneath it. A cursor glyph moves to the button and presses it, the button scaling down and springing back.
build: The card is a fixed DOM panel; the cursor path is power3.inOut with a 0.045s press scale (0.82) and a 0.14s release, same mechanic as glass-ui-flow's cursor.
sound: A soft slide as the cursor arrives and a distinct click on the press.
prompt: Hold a product card beside a short pricing statement and a call-to-action button, then animate a cursor gliding to the button and pressing it down with a quick spring release, as the simple, low-friction close to the pitch.
